title: [Data federation] Introduce storybook in data federation
body:
Closes https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/293262

## Summary
Adds the Storybook setup for the Data Federation plugin, extracted from #289171 so that PR only carries the mapping editor. Includes a story for `ConfirmDeleteDataSetModal` so Storybook isn't empty.

### Test plan
Run `pnpm storybook data_federation` and open Data Federation → Confirm delete dataset modal.
